title: Remote critical banner
summary: One banner above the chat list for critical notices only: an outage, a forced update or a change of terms (ADR 0117). Bipe's server sets it; the app shows it without a new build.

id.description: The banner id. A new id shows again to people who closed an older one.

mode.description: notice: opens link and can be closed. update: the app is below min_app_version; opens the store page and cannot be closed.

target.description: notice: link. update: update_links for this platform.

banner.description: Missing when the server has no banner, it expired, or the person closed this id.

refresh.effect: Fetches GET /v1/banner when the chat list appears and when the app comes to the foreground, at most once a minute. A failure keeps the last banner until it expires.

open.effect: Opens target: the store page for update, the in-app browser for notice.

dismiss.effect: notice only: hides the banner and stores its id on the phone, so that id does not show again.

notes: Move, do not rewrite: BipeKit BipeRemoteBanner.swift (state(appVersion:now:), compareVersions) and libraries/bipe banner/BipeRemoteBannerStore.kt. Reference: remoteBannerState() in tools/lib/registries.mjs; cases in test-vectors/remote-banner.json; contract RemoteBanner in api/openapi.yaml.
The app version is the version name of product/version.json.

Title and text come from the server in pt-BR only and show as they are. The button labels are app strings: bipe_remote_banner_update on an update banner, bipe_remote_banner_dismiss as the close label.
The banner sits above the account-task slot (recovery key, inviter row) and above the requests row. It shows on the Conversas and Grupos tabs (ADR 0053).
News never uses this banner: news goes to the Novidades chat (ADR 0117).
The fetch has no auth and sends nothing about the person.
